title: Import git YAML corpus into local GraphQL Items
description:
Implement import of canonical git YAML annotations into local GraphQL Items. Do not invent a second corpus. Behavior is specified by the gold-Item stories under this epic.

Plexus storage is plx-765ff0 (Virtuus behind FastAPI). This task is the DataParade-side importer and dataset wiring.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Importer implemented on feature/DATAP-9709a7: positive non-rejected YAML → Items via local GraphQL, keyed by externalId.
